verdict.rationale: Pulley documents the building pieces of this story: stock option templates, in-app e-signing and grant-acceptance tracking, equity plan capacity, board management under compliance, and an in-house 409A valuation service. No evidence shows these joined into one grant workflow where a board approves the option and the strike price is set from the 409A. Missing for 10: a documented board approval step for option grants, strike price automatically tied to the current 409A, evidence of a single end-to-end new-hire grant flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow
